conditions.no_hold: Previous policy target retained during inference; no boundary state read.
conditions.old_holding: At each inference boundary, read qpos again, send hold at that reading, refresh latest observation frame with new qpos and unchanged previous policy target, then infer.
conditions.new_holding: Reuse the action-period-end qpos (startup sample for chunk 0), freeze observation first, send hold from the same qpos without any additional read/history update, then infer. Hold acknowledgement remains synchronous; no parallel inference.
